anatomy.p: Print, foil, screen, relief and die, all landing in the same place.
items: Multicolour digital printing
Blacks, greys and all illustrated parts, including the fine landscape.
Premium textured paper
Ivory natural stock with visible fibre.
Hot foil gold
Logo, frames, flourishes, leaves, grapes and lettering.
Foil and relief combined
Gold that also rises from the surface.
Embossing
Raised flourishes, side elements and some lettering.
Debossing
Decorative areas pressed into the paper.
Opaque screen printing
Dense black and blue in the lower field and the medallion.
High-build screen varnish
Floral motifs with a strong tactile relief.
Selective screen varnish
Gloss against matt on the dark areas.
Microtexture
Very fine relief patterns in grounds and side panels.
Raised tactile details
Raised dots under “Cuvée Prestige”.
Complex shaped die-cut
A fully contoured, non-rectangular profile.
Precision die-cutting
Points, curves and recesses on the perimeter.
Multi-process registration
Foil, relief, screen and print landing together.

technologies.lead: Each technology does one thing well. The value is in combining them on the same label, in register.

items.title: Digital printing
items.text: High-resolution digital colour, from short runs to industrial volumes.

items.title: Hot foil
items.text: Metallic foil applied with heat and pressure: gold, silver, holographic or custom.

items.title: Screen printing
items.text: Dense, opaque colour and thick varnish layers on top of the print.

items.title: Embossing
items.text: Relief raised from the paper, on its own or in register with foil.

items.title: Debossing
items.text: Details pressed into the surface for a quieter, engraved look.

items.title: High-build tactile effects
items.text: Thick varnish you can feel under a fingertip.

items.title: Microtextures
items.text: Fine relief patterns that change how a surface catches the light.

items.title: Die-cutting
items.text: Shaped profiles with points, curves and recesses, cut in register.

items.title: Reverse printing
items.text: Printing on the adhesive side, seen through the container or the product.

items.title: Multilayer / booklet labels
items.text: More room for text without a bigger label.

items.title: Variable data
items.text: Codes, names, batches and QR codes that change on every label.

items.title: Numbering
items.text: Sequential numbers for limited editions and traceability.

items.title: Lamination
items.text: A protective film over the print, gloss or matt.

items.title: Colour measurement and control
items.text: Spectral colour measurement, checked against the target.

items: Which materials suit an ice bucket?
We propose materials and adhesives selected for wet and chilled conditions. Tell us how the bottle is served and we send samples to test on your own bottles.
Can you print small runs and limited editions?
Yes. Short runs are printed digitally, with variable data and numbering where needed.
Can foil and embossing be combined on the same detail?
Yes. Foil can be applied flat or raised, in register with the print and the die-cut.
Do you deliver outside Italy?
Yes. We produce in Trieste and deliver across Europe.
